evidence_type: actual registered local workflows; deterministic offline providers; no live LLM or API
limitations: Synthetic offline smoke benchmark; no LLM, clinical API, patient data or clinical efficacy evidence.
Twenty scenario composition families with three within-family variants each; 60 cases are not 60 independent clinical tasks.
Validation and test add held-out compositions of shared primitives; no claim of out-of-domain generalization.
Public repository fixtures are locked by runner protocol, not hidden from developers.
